faqs.question: Do we need special handheld scanners, or will phones work?
faqs.answer: Both work. The app reads barcodes and QR codes through a normal Android or iPhone camera, and it also pairs with rugged Bluetooth and Zebra-style handheld scanners for high-volume warehouses. We help you choose the right mix for each site.

faqs.question: Can it keep stock accurate across several warehouses and branches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every warehouse, store, and even individual bins are tracked separately, while you still see consolidated totals across the whole company. Transfers between sites are scanned at dispatch and receipt so in-transit stock is never lost.

faqs.question: What happens when the warehouse loses internet?
faqs.answer: The scanning app keeps working offline. Receipts, picks, and counts are stored on the device and sync automatically the moment the connection returns, so the team never stops working and nothing is double-counted.

faqs.question: Can it connect to our accounting or ERP system?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate the inventory app with your accounting, ERP, POS, or e-commerce platform through their APIs so stock, valuations, and sales stay in sync. If you have no system yet, the app can stand on its own and connect later.

faqs.question: Will it support Arabic and our existing barcode labels?
faqs.answer: The interface is fully bilingual Arabic and English with right-to-left support, and it reads your current supplier and EAN/UPC barcodes as-is. We can also generate and print new labels for items that do not have one yet.
